content.title: “The Bible has been rewritten so many times.”
content.context: A colleague has heard that no original meaning can be recovered.
content.question: Which question helps you investigate together?
options: There are no differences between any manuscripts.
Every other ancient text is worse.
Is there a particular passage or manuscript claim we could look at?

explanation.text: Make the claim specific and open the evidence. Different translations, copying variants and the history of the canon are different issues. Ask which one your colleague means.

content.prompt: Draft one clarifying question and one source you could examine together.
content.label: The Bible
